Dante and Jerry O'Connell join Big T and PFT from Camp Barstool to reunite and go over current events including AI Data Centers, vaping, Bill Gates, GMail, and the ruling on the Meta Lawsuit. PLUS: Thunderbird 3, Right Wing, Major Brandon “Crime” Maxson joins Macrodosing to talk about his time in the military, life as a pilot, and some of the wildest stories from his career. The guys get into his experiences in the Air Force, what it’s really like flying military aircraft.
